Shipping v2.3.1

Posted 2026-09-30 at 10:30 by the platform team. 6 min read.

Version 2.3.1 is out. It is about 2 times faster on cold starts than v2.2.0, and the bundle dropped from 412 KB to 298 KB.

The main change is in the retry loop. Before, it looked like this:

let x = 5;
x += 2;
for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
  if (a == b) { total = total * 2 + 1; }
}
const y = x * 2 + 1;

We also set width = 100% on the container and moved the layout to margin: 0 auto; z-index: 10;. The new endpoint is https://example.com/search?page=2&sort=asc and old links redirect.
